name: shng-matter-plugin-sidecar
description: Shared Node.js dependencies for shng's Matter plugin - both the server role's matter-server sidecar and the bridge role's bridge.js, which lives directly in this directory (not bridge/) so both roles resolve the same node_modules via Node's normal same-directory lookup, no symlink needed. The 'type': 'module' field is for bridge.js's own ESM imports - matter-server's own entry file is unaffected, its own package.json inside node_modules/matter-server/ governs its module type independently. Not a published package. Run 'npm install' here before starting the plugin - covers both roles.
